lines: Come in, mind the crate, it is a chair, we have all agreed it is a chair.
I am second desk at the Foundation and I bring the ledgers home,
which is against the rules and which everybody on this stair does.
The rent went up twice this year and the sitting room became a bedroom.
It is not a hardship. It is just how a hundred and sixty thousand people fit.
I have never been outside the city. Not once. Not even to the river mouth.
Mother says the sea is four days that way. I do not believe in it.
Have you seen it? Was it like the model in the atrium?
